from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-004924d8.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    frame = grid[0][0]
    width = 0
    while width < len(grid[0]) and grid[0][width] == frame:
        width += 1
    separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == frame for v in row[:width])]

    unseen = {(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c in range(width, len(row)) if row[c] != 0}
    shapes = []
    while unseen:
        start = next(iter(unseen))
        color = grid[start[0]][start[1]]
        todo = [start]
        unseen.remove(start)
        cells = {start}
        while todo:
            r, c = todo.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in unseen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color:
                    unseen.remove(q)
                    todo.append(q)
                    cells.add(q)
        r0, c0 = min(r for r,c in cells), min(c for r,c in cells)
        shape = frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)
        shapes.append((color, shape))

    for top, bottom in zip(separators, separators[1:]):
        holes = {(r-top-1, c) for r in range(top+1,bottom) for c in range(1,width-1) if grid[r][c] == 0}
        if not holes:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r,c in holes)
        c0 = min(c for r,c in holes)
        shape = frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in holes)
        color = next(color for color, candidate in shapes if candidate == shape)
        for r,c in holes:
            grid[top+1+r][c] = color
    return [row[:width] for row in grid]
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(code)
print('saved',p)
